security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Google AI Mode, with a searchable local library
bundle.longDescription: A lightweight desktop client for Google AI Mode searches and follow-ups. Conversations are saved locally as JSON and Markdown, organised into projects, fully searchable, and optionally synced to GitHub and JSONBin.
